column1: # ESV Chronological Bible — Daily Reading Index, transcribed from the printed
# volume (Crossway). Day <TAB> reading reference string, exactly as printed.
# BUILD INPUT ONLY. This file is not imported by the site and is not served:
# the arrangement of scripture into 365 chronological readings is Crossway's
# editorial work, and republishing it wholesale is a different thing from
# publishing counts derived from it. What ships is the aggregate — verses per
# book per day — which is what the original Flourish version published too.
# Transcribed 2026-08-03 from photographs of pp. 1769ff. Correctness is not
# assumed: scripts/build-chrono-sankey.mjs asserts that the plan covers every
# verse of all 66 books exactly once, with no gaps and no overlaps, so a
# mis-read chapter or verse number fails the build and names the book.
# Separators are reproduced as printed: ';' continues a reading, '|' marks
# where the volume breaks to a new interleaved block.
